title: fix: reject mixed prefill replay modes in Pareto plots
body:
`load_points()` allows prefill results with identical `yoco_clip` values but different `yoco_clip_mask` values to appear on the same Pareto curve. Compact and mask modes perform different amounts of computation, so combining them produces a curve with inconsistent benchmark configurations.

Add `yoco_clip_mask` to the fixed prefill configuration fields. Four regression cases verify that mixed modes are rejected in either order and that matching compact or mask records load successfully. The tests run on CPU and carry both `ci` and `ci_npu` markers, following [[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/774ce244b87cc0eb8d4b94ab9f5de2ab22049f01/CONTRIBUTING.md#core-test-markers)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/774ce244b87cc0eb8d4b94ab9f5de2ab22049f01/CONTRIBUTING.md#core-test-markers).

Validation completed with Python 3.12:

- `python -m pytest -q --basetemp=.cache/pytest tests/test_plot_pareto.py` — 4 passed.
- `ruff check --no-cache examples/sweep/plot_pareto.py tests/test_plot_pareto.py` — passed.
- `ruff format --check --no-cache examples/sweep/plot_pareto.py tests/test_plot_pareto.py` — passed.
